global_caption: The video contains 6 shots. It is a realistic, high-saturation jewelry advertisement set in a dreamy chase within a candy-themed microscopic forest, culminating in a dramatic reveal of the diamond ring. The overall palette features berry red, cream pink, and caramel gold, complemented by cool white diamond refractions. Lighting relies on soft side light and bright mirror reflections. The camera movement is lively and fluid, gradually building toward the product's heroic moment. Throughout, Chinese dreamy light
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a wide overhead dolly-in composition. A blueberry stream winds from the lower left toward the center depth, with giant strawberries, macaron trees, and icing-covered moss layered to form clear leading lines. Foreground leaves sparkle with sugar crystals, while a faint cold-white reflection of the ring appears in the background as a visual focal point. Soft daylight mixed with sugar surface reflections makes the entire forest translucent and radiant. A big-eyed fairy leaps from the foreground into the edge of the stream, running joyfully toward that glimmer. In the upper-left corner, semi-transparent 3D text with refractive texture densely displays "折射每一束目光", while "火彩一触即亮" emerges along the stream’s flow in the lower-right, edges adorned with fine rainbow trim and subtly flickering as the lens advances. The camera slowly lowers and pushes forward overhead.
shot2: Shot 2 cuts hard from the previous shot, transitioning to a medium eye-level follow shot. The fairy leaps upward along a thick cookie tree root. Tree bark texture and baking cracks rush past in the near foreground, creating a sense of speed. The background continues the blueberry stream and icing moss, maintaining natural continuity. A warm golden side light sweeps across the end of the root, precisely revealing the metal outline of the band and several prong settings. The ring remains partially hidden. Composition places the fairy on the left moving right, positioning the band’s silhouette in the right highlight zone as the chase target. The camera tracks horizontally close to ground level with slight upward tilt. Clothing and wings flutter with motion.
shot3: Shot 3 cuts hard at the action point, using a close-up low-angle shot. The fairy lands on a sugar crystal rock beside the ring. Blurred sugar particles in the foreground create shallow depth of field. Focus locks on its extended fingertip and the top of the main stone. Warm side light outlines the hand, while cool white highlights inside the diamond build clear internal layers. As the fingertip gently touches the main stone, multi-faceted refraction instantly explodes into rainbow fire, radiating fine beams that illuminate surrounding strawberry skin and icing moss. Large text "高折射" pops up slightly above center, rendered in mirror-crystal chrome material, appearing with a brief zoom and sparkling trail. The camera first slightly pushes in, then subtly tilts up, amplifying the shock of the diamond’s expansion.
shot4: Shot 4 transitions via a flash-white fire burst, cutting to an extreme close-up nearly macro eye-level shot. The lens faces directly at the diamond surface, which fills most of the frame. The background blurs into soft cream-colored bokeh. Focus penetrates the facets, revealing the fairy’s enlarged, surprised face and shining eyes. Cool white highlights glide across the facets. The camera continues an extremely slow push-in with ultra-shallow depth of field, immersing viewers as if entering the diamond’s interior.
shot5: Shot 5 cuts hard from the previous shot, entering a macro orbit shot. The ring hovers above sugar crystal pollen, rotating slowly. Floating golden sugar particles and translucent pollen clusters in the foreground create layering. Background shows softly blurred macaron treetops and berry-colored forest. Composition centers the ring slightly right of the axis, keeping the diamond as the visual core. Side-backlight creates a thin bright outline along the band’s edge, clearly showing metal curvature and facet lines. The camera orbits clockwise in micro-macro motion, matching the ring’s rotation. Pollen lifts with airflow, forming delicate streams. Along the bottom, following the ring’s arc, sequential subtitles "净透 切工 火彩" appear one by one.
shot6: Shot 6 transitions via a highlight flash cut, landing on a hero close-up. Using a near close-up slightly low-angle composition, the ring stands centered on a caramel-textured pedestal. The platform’s edge features detailed pulled-sugar textures and amber-like transparent reflections. Giant strawberries and icing moss in the background blur into soft high-saturation color blocks. All attention is drawn to the central main stone. Warm golden key light from the back-right casts a noble silhouette. Cool white fill light makes the diamond’s fire jump and sparkle in layers. The camera first moves extremely slowly forward, then slightly rises, finally freezing at the fullest fire angle. It fades in from mist and settles steadily. The background The entire ad concludes with a freeze-frame featuring product, slogan, and brand together.
